fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-05-02, around 18:50, the purse of the complainant with cash and cards was allegedly lifted while queueing at Nallur Puram Market Road, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-05-02. The complainant, Deepa Kumari, provided the contact number 9000000272. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-69-YY-1061. Vasanthi Bai (mobile 9000000115) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, bus, mobile number, vehicle observation, market road, evening, CCTV
